title: Scary skibox
script:
-- // SETTINGS //
local IMAGE_ID = "rbxassetid://80931798597888"
local MUSIC_ID = "rbxassetid://125995364970231"
local PITCH = 0.09
local VOL = 9999999999999999999

-- // SKYBOX EXECUTION //
local function ApplyScarySky()
    local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
    sky.Name = "ScarySkyBox"
    sky.SkyboxBk = IMAGE_ID
    sky.SkyboxDn = IMAGE_ID
    sky.SkyboxFt = IMAGE_ID
    sky.SkyboxLf = IMAGE_ID
    sky.SkyboxRt = IMAGE_ID
    sky.SkyboxUp = IMAGE_ID
    sky.Parent = game:GetService("Lighting")
    
    -- Force atmosphere to match the vibe
    game:GetService("Lighting").FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    game:GetService("Lighting").FogEnd = 100
end

-- // MUSIC EXECUTION //
local function PlayScaryMusic()
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound.Name = "ScaryMusic"
    sound.SoundId = MUSIC_ID
    sound.Pitch = PITCH
    sound.Volume = VOL
    sound.Looped = true
    sound.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
    sound:Play()
end

-- // RUN //
ApplyScarySky()
PlayScaryMusic()

print("Scary Sky Enabled. Good luck.")

-- // STOP COMMAND (Optional) //
-- To stop the script, run: game:GetService("SoundService").ScaryMusic:Destroy()
